from collections import deque

q = deque()
q.append(10)
q.append(20)

print(q.popleft())

linked_list.python:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.next = None

head = Node(10)
head.next = Node(20)
head.next.next = Node(30)

cur = head
while cur:
    print(cur.data, end = ' -> ' if cur.next else '')
    cur = cur.next

class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

root = Node(10)
root.left = Node(5)
root.right = Node(15)

dynamic_programming.python:
dp = [0] * 6
dp[1] = 1

for i in range(2, 6):
    dp[i] = dp[i - 1] + dp[i - 2]

print(dp[5])
